title: Controls, State Estimation, Guidance, and Navigation
purpose: Learn how physical systems evolve, how feedback changes them, and how controllers behave when sensors, actuators, and timing are imperfect.
progression_rule: Complete modules in order until the first eight are complete; later modules may be selected when their prerequisites are met.
